deadline.value: Doctoral applications can be made at any time, though committees do not meet during lecture-free periods, so delays may occur.
deadline.quote: You may apply and be admitted at any time.

gre_subject.value: The regulations mention no GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: The applicant should propose a supervisor where possible.
supervisor.quote: Where possible, the applicant should propose a supervisor for their doctoral project

funding.value: The regulations do not say whether doctoral students are funded.

entry_route.value: A master's degree in a subject closely related to the doctoral field is required to be eligible.
entry_route.quote: To be eligible for doctoral research, the applicant must have successfully obtained a master’s degree in a subject closely related to their proposed doctoral field

english_waiver.value: English proof is required only if the doctoral work is in English, at a level the fetched text does not show; the doctoral board decides the form.
english_waiver.quote: If doctoral work is to be completed in English, proof of proficiency in English at the level
